baseLedgerPolicy: The 2026-07-21 migration ledger is hash-locked cutover evidence. This supplement indexes later approved decisions without rewriting that dated artifact.

decisions.title: Canonical foundation release 1.0.0
decisions.scope: Portable typography, colour, space-layout and geometry-controls foundation release
decisions.summary: Lock the four separately approved foundation packages into the canonical portable foundations release without changing their bounded authority or token values.

decisions.title: Canonical Global Navigation component
decisions.scope: Global Navigation Registry family, variants, responsive behaviour and bounded five-core motion exception
decisions.summary: Lock the quiet Living Registry, compact five-circle family cue, primary dark and bounded light surfaces, footer-free disclosure, accessibility behaviour, static fallbacks and the navigation-only five-live-core exception.

decisions.title: First canonical Golden Homepage design reference
decisions.scope: Golden Homepage visual, responsive, interaction and composition reference
decisions.summary: Lock the complete Round 28 homepage as the first canonical Mez Systems golden visual reference while keeping production packaging, consumer integration, release-safe proof media and independent component promotions outside its authority.

decisions.title: Canonical Halftone Portrait component
decisions.scope: Dependency-free Halftone Portrait render, accessibility, failure and bounded motion contract
decisions.summary: Promote the exact CMP-05 candidate with its locked halftone treatment, default one-live allocation, complete static meaning, offscreen idling and explicit motion-policy=always exception. Accept the optional invert limitation and keep the utility outside the Phase B product-and-commerce pantry.

decisions.title: Canonical Testimonial Marquee component
decisions.scope: Locked social-caption testimonial rail, fixture boundary, accessibility, frozen follower evidence and bounded motion contracts
decisions.summary: Promote the exact CMP-06 Round 04 candidate with seven video-backed testimonials, no Daniel record, frozen dated follower snapshots, native interaction, static-complete reduced motion and the reconfirmed continuous-drift exception. Defer exact VoiceOver speech, physical-pointer timing and device profiling to named consumer proof.
